plan.title: Single-stage RFQ delivery date before bidding end

steps.note: Open the Single Stage create screen.
Verify the Events list and Create Event control rendered.
Verify the Create Event menu offers the Single Stage path.
Change the initial event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Select the RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the CYLINDER product with the requested quantity.
Populate required pricing-sheet fields for the line item.
Set the bidding window to end approximately tomorrow.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFQ create screen, set the first line item's Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), set the delivery date to today while the bidding end remains tomorrow, and stop with the configured date visible.

steps.note: Configure the delivery location and the delivery date, which are not fully parameterized by catalog schedule steps.
Attempt to publish the event with delivery before bidding end.
Verify the application produces a delivery-date-related warning or refusal rather than accepting the conflict silently.
